usage.callShape: GET https://pro-api.coingecko.com/api/v3/x402/onchain/simple/networks/{network}/token_price/{address} — path segments only, no body or query params. The registry-declared POST returns 404; use GET.
usage.outputShape: body.data.attributes.token_prices.<address> — USD price as a string, or absent/empty object ({}) if CoinGecko has no onchain price for that contract; body.data.type is always 'simple_token_price'
quirks: MUST use GET, not POST. The registry lists method=POST but POST returns HTTP 404 {"error":"Incorrect path"} (caught on the unpaid pre-flight, so no money is lost) — only GET routes correctly and charges $0.01.

token_prices may be an empty object {} (or the address key may be null) for contracts CoinGecko does not track on that network — this is a valid 200 OK, NOT an error. WMON 0x760AfE86e5de5fa0Ee542fc7B7B713e1c5425701 on monad returned {} during this test.
Output path is body.data.attributes.token_prices.<address> — one level shallower than the prior existingUsage note (body.data.data.attributes was wrong).
No query params or request body are accepted; network slug + contract address are path segments. Pay $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) or Solana via x402.
This backend hardcodes network=monad in the path; swap the :address segment for the target contract. For other networks use the {network} variant.
usage.guide: Call this with GET (NOT the POST the registry lists — POST 404s for free, GET is the working verb). Put the network slug (this backend uses 'monad') and the ERC-20/token contract address as path segments; send no body and no query params. Pay $0.01 USDC on Base via x402. Read the USD price from body.data.attributes.token_prices.<address> as a string. If token_prices is {} or the address is null, the contract simply isn't tracked onchain by CoinGecko for that network — treat it as a valid 'no data' 200, not a failure.
